mapper.insert: INSERT INTO zhi_article_daily_stats (article_id, stat_date, pv, uv) VALUES (#{articleId}, #{statDate}, #{pv}, #{uv}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE pv = VALUES(pv), uv = VALUES(uv), update_time = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT stat_date AS statDate, SUM(pv) AS pv, SUM(uv) AS uv FROM zhi_article_daily_stats WHERE stat_date >= #{startDate} GROUP BY stat_date ORDER BY stat_date ASC
